```{r}

    meta_stock_file= "/amova_lists/SSL_stocklist_amova.txt",

run_amova_phist <- function(vcf_file, meta_file, species, chr, outdir = ".", by="stock") {

  vcf <- read.vcfR(vcf_file, verbose = FALSE)

  gt  <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")
  ref <- vcf@fix[, "REF"]
  alt <- vcf@fix[, "ALT"]

  # DNA matrix from haploid GT (0/1/.)
  dna_mat <- matrix(NA_character_,
                    nrow = nrow(gt), ncol = ncol(gt),
                    dimnames = list(rownames(gt), colnames(gt)))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gt))) {
    dna_mat[i, gt[i, ] == "0"] <- ref[i]
    dna_mat[i, gt[i, ] == "1"] <- alt[i]
    dna_mat[i, gt[i, ] == "."] <- "N"
  }

  dna <- as.DNAbin(t(dna_mat))  # samples in rows

  # meta data (population/stock info)
  meta <- read.table(meta_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t")

  meta$SampleID   <- trimws(meta$SampleID)
  if (by == "pop") {
    meta$Group <- trimws(meta$Population)
  } else if (by == "stock") {
    meta$Group <- trimws(meta$Group)
  } else if (by == "stock.k2") {
    meta$Group <- trimws(meta$GroupK2)
  } else {
    meta$Group <- trimws(meta$Group)
  }
  pop <- setNames(meta$Group, meta$SampleID)
  pop <- pop[rownames(dna)]
  pop <- factor(pop)

  # drop samples with missing population annotation
  keep <- !is.na(pop)
  dna  <- dna[keep, ]
  pop  <- droplevels(pop[keep])

  # distances (haploid sequence distances, N treated as ambiguity)
  D <- dist.dna(dna, model = "N", pairwise.deletion = TRUE, as.matrix = FALSE)
  Dmat <- as.matrix(D)  # for pairwise subsetting

  if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

  # ----------------
  # Global AMOVA
  # ----------------
  amova_global <- amova(D ~ pop)

  global_out <- file.path(outdir, paste0("global_", species, "_", chr, ".txt"))
  sink(global_out)
  cat("VCF:  ", vcf_file, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("META: ", meta_file, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n--- Base composition (DNAbin) ---\n")
  print(base.freq(dna))
  cat("\n--- Sample counts by population (used) ---\n")
  print(table(pop))
  cat("\n--- Global AMOVA ---\n")
  print(amova_global)
  sink()

  # ----------------
  # Pairwise AMOVA
  # ----------------
  pops <- levels(pop)

  for (i in seq_along(pops)) {
    for (j in seq_along(pops)) {
      if (i < j) {

        idx <- pop %in% pops[c(i, j)]
        pop_ij <- droplevels(pop[idx])

        # if one pop is missing after filtering, or any pop has <2 samples, skip but still write a file
        pair_out <- file.path(outdir, paste0(by, "_", species, "_", chr, "_", pops[i], "_", pops[j], ".txt"))
        sink(pair_out)

        cat("VCF:  ", vcf_file, "\n", sep = "")
        cat("META: ", meta_file, "\n", sep = "")
        cat("Pop1: ", pops[i], "\n", sep = "")
        cat("Pop2: ", pops[j], "\n", sep = "")
        cat("\n--- Sample counts in this comparison ---\n")
        print(table(pop_ij))

        if (nlevels(pop_ij) < 2) {
          cat("\nSKIPPED: only one population present after subsetting.\n")
          sink()
          next
        }

        if (any(table(pop_ij) < 2)) {
          cat("\nSKIPPED: need >=2 samples per population for stable AMOVA.\n")
          sink()
          next
        }

        Dij <- as.dist(Dmat[idx, idx])
        am  <- amova(Dij ~ pop_ij)

        cat("\n--- Pairwise AMOVA ---\n")
        print(am)

        sink()
      }
    }
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run everything
# ------------------------------------------------------------
outdir <- "/amova_phist"

for (nm in names(runs)) {
  x <- runs[[nm]]
  run_amova_phist(
    vcf_file = x$vcf_file,
    meta_file = x$meta_stock_file,
    species = x$species,
    chr = x$chr,
    outdir = outdir,
    by="stock.k3"
  )
  run_amova_phist(
    vcf_file = x$vcf_file,
    meta_file = x$meta_stock_file,
    species = x$species,
    chr = x$chr,
    outdir = outdir,
    by="stock.k2"
  )
  run_amova_phist(
    vcf_file = x$vcf_file,
    meta_file = x$meta_pop_file,
    species = x$species,
    chr = x$chr,
    outdir = outdir,
    by="pop"
  )
}
```
